searchText: For eth2 client devs: I think we should sort out the remaining small differences how beacon configs are formatted. I've built a tool to essentially "lint" a config. Details here: https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-specs/issues/2055 Also, I'm nearing completion of a new prototype of a hive (eth1 testing)-like test runner, but for eth2 tests. Builds containers, keystores, states, etc. all to then run network/integration tests on. Standardization like reading the exact same custom config would be very helpful. Is the idea to standardize on using the exact fields and types as in the config thats in the spec? https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-specs/blob/dev/configs/mainnet/phase0.yaml Yea, the linter should pass without errors on the spec config And then there's this file: https://github.com/protolambda/eth2-config-tester/blob/master/config_spec.yaml which would explicitly state what formatting type each config var is, without spreading it across documents or making the python->yaml tranlation unclear
